import filters = "./filters.qui"

int[][] neighbors(int width, int height, int x, int y)
    int[][] result := []
    for: -1 <= dy < 2
        for: -1 <= dx < 2
            nx := x + dx
            ny := y + dy
            if (dx != 0 or dy != 0) and 0 <= nx < width and 0 <= ny < height
                result = result.append([nx, ny])
    return result

int[][] directions(int[][] gx, int[][] gy)
    int[][] result := []
    for: y < int(#gx)
        int[] row := []
        for: x < int(#gx[0])
            horizontal := gx[y][x]
            vertical := gy[y][x]
            ax := filters.absolute(horizontal)
            ay := filters.absolute(vertical)
            direction := if 29 * ay <= 12 * ax then 0 elif 29 * ay >= 70 * ax then 90 elif horizontal * vertical < 0 then 45 else 135
            row = row.append(direction)
        result = result.append(row)
    return result

int[][] suppress(int[][] magnitude, int[][] direction)
    height := int(#magnitude)
    width := int(#magnitude[0])
    result := [for y := (0:<int(height))[] then [for x := (0:<int(width))[] then 0]]
    for: 1 <= y < height - 1
        for: 1 <= x < width - 1
            angle := direction[y][x]
            dx := if angle == 0 or angle == 135 then -1 elif angle == 45 then 1 else 0
            dy := if angle == 0 then 0 else -1
            value := magnitude[y][x]
            if value > magnitude[y + dy][x + dx] and value >= magnitude[y - dy][x - dx]
                result[y][x] = value
    return result

class Hysteresis(bool[][] edges, bool[][] strong, bool[][] weak)

Hysteresis hysteresis(int[][] nonmax, int low, int high)
    height := int(#nonmax)
    width := int(#nonmax[0])
    edges := [for y := (0:<int(height))[] then [for x := (0:<int(width))[] then false]]
    strong := edges
    weak := edges
    int[][] queue := []
    for: y < height
        for: x < width
            value := nonmax[y][x]
            if value >= high
                strong[y][x] = true
                edges[y][x] = true
                queue = queue.append([x, y])
            elif value >= low
                weak[y][x] = true
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#queue)
        point := queue[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        for next := neighbors(width, height, point[0], point[1])[]
            x := next[0]
            y := next[1]
            if not edges[y][x] and (strong[y][x] or weak[y][x])
                edges[y][x] = true
                queue = queue.append(next)
    return Hysteresis(edges, strong, weak)

int[][][] components(bool[][] edges)
    height := int(#edges)
    width := int(#edges[0])
    visited := [for y := (0:<int(height))[] then [for x := (0:<int(width))[] then false]]
    int[][][] result := []
    for: y < height
        for: x < width
            if not edges[y][x] or visited[y][x]
                continue
            int[][] queue := [[x, y]]
            visited[y][x] = true
            cursor := 0
            while cursor < int(#queue)
                point := queue[cursor]
                cursor += 1
                for next := neighbors(width, height, point[0], point[1])[]
                    nx := next[0]
                    ny := next[1]
                    if edges[ny][nx] and not visited[ny][nx]
                        visited[ny][nx] = true
                        queue = queue.append(next)
            result = result.append(queue)
    return result

import filters = "./filters.qui"

class Detection(int[][] response, int[][] candidates)

Detection detect(int[][] gx, int[][] gy, int window, int threshold)
    height := int(#gx)
    width := int(#gx[0])
    half := window / 2
    int[][] response := []
    for: y < height
        int[] row := []
        for: x < width
            xx := 0
            yy := 0
            xy := 0
            for: -half <= dy < half + 1
                for: -half <= dx < half + 1
                    horizontal := filters.clamped(gx, x + dx, y + dy)
                    vertical := filters.clamped(gy, x + dx, y + dy)
                    xx += horizontal * horizontal
                    yy += vertical * vertical
                    xy += horizontal * vertical
            row = row.append(xx * yy - xy * xy - (xx + yy) * (xx + yy) / 25)
        response = response.append(row)
    int[][] candidates := []
    maximum := 0
    for: y < height
        for: x < width
            value := response[y][x]
            if value < threshold
                continue
            peak := true
            for: -1 <= dy < 2
                for: -1 <= dx < 2
                    nx := x + dx
                    ny := y + dy
                    if (dx == 0 and dy == 0) or nx < 0 or nx >= width or ny < 0 or ny >= height
                        continue
                    other := response[ny][nx]
                    if other > value or (other == value and (ny < y or (ny == y and nx < x)))
                        peak = false
            if peak
                candidates = candidates.append([x, y, value])
                if value > maximum
                    maximum = value
    base := int(#candidates) + 1
    int[] keys := []
    for: i < int(#candidates)
        row := candidates[i]
        order := ((maximum - row[2]) * height + row[1]) * width + row[0]
        keys = keys.append(order * base + i)
    ordered := [for key := keys.sorted()[] then candidates[key % base]]
    return Detection(response, ordered)

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

int clamp(int value, int low, int high)
    return if value < low then low elif value > high then high else value

int clamped(int[][] image, int x, int y)
    return image[clamp(y, 0, int(#image) - 1)][clamp(x, 0, int(#image[0]) - 1)]

int[][] smoothing(int[][] image, int size, int[] kernel, int divisor)
    half := size / 2
    int[][] result := []
    for: y < int(#image)
        int[] row := []
        for: x < int(#image[0])
            total := 0
            for: j < size
                for: i < size
                    total += kernel[j * size + i] * clamped(image, x + i - half, y + j - half)
            row = row.append(total / divisor)
        result = result.append(row)
    return result

class Gradient(int[][] gx, int[][] gy, int[][] magnitude)

Gradient gradient(int[][] image)
    int[][] gx := []
    int[][] gy := []
    int[][] magnitude := []
    for: y < int(#image)
        int[] row_x := []
        int[] row_y := []
        int[] strengths := []
        for: x < int(#image[0])
            int[] q := []
            for: -1 <= dy < 2
                for: -1 <= dx < 2
                    q = q.append(clamped(image, x + dx, y + dy))
            horizontal := (q[2] + 2 * q[5] + q[8]) - (q[0] + 2 * q[3] + q[6])
            vertical := (q[6] + 2 * q[7] + q[8]) - (q[0] + 2 * q[1] + q[2])
            row_x = row_x.append(horizontal)
            row_y = row_y.append(vertical)
            strengths = strengths.append(absolute(horizontal) + absolute(vertical))
        gx = gx.append(row_x)
        gy = gy.append(row_y)
        magnitude = magnitude.append(strengths)
    return Gradient(gx, gy, magnitude)

int smaller(int first, int second)
    return if first < second then first else second

int larger(int first, int second)
    return if first > second then first else second

int floor_divide(int numerator, int denominator)
    return if numerator >= 0 then numerator / denominator else -((-numerator + denominator - 1) / denominator)

int rho(int[] point, int angle, int[][] trig, int step)
    row := trig[angle]
    return floor_divide(point[0] * row[0] + point[1] * row[1], 16384 * step)

int[][] circle_points(int radius)
    int[][] result := []
    distinct<int> seen
    a := radius
    b := 0
    error_value := 1 - radius
    while a >= b
        int[][] points := [[a, b], [b, a], [-b, a], [-a, b], [-a, -b], [-b, -a], [b, -a], [a, -b]]
        for point := points[]
            key := (point[1] + radius) * (2 * radius + 1) + point[0] + radius
            if not seen.has(key)
                .seen.add(key)
                result = result.append(point)
        b += 1
        if error_value < 0
            error_value += 2 * b + 1
        else
            a -= 1
            error_value += 2 * (b - a) + 1
    return result

class CircleVotes(int[][] cells, int[][][] outlines, int low, int high)
class CirclePeak(int radius, int x, int y, int votes, int point_count)
class CirclePeaks(int candidate_count, CirclePeak[] peaks)

CircleVotes circle_votes(int[][] edges, int width, int height, int low, int high)
    int[][] cells := []
    int[][][] outlines := []
    for: low <= radius < high + 1
        votes := [for i := (0:<int(width * height))[] then 0]
        offsets := circle_points(radius)
        outlines = outlines.append(offsets)
        for point := edges[]
            for offset := offsets[]
                x := point[0] + offset[0]
                y := point[1] + offset[1]
                if 0 <= x < width and 0 <= y < height
                    votes[y * width + x] += 1
        cells = cells.append(votes)
    return CircleVotes(cells, outlines, low, high)

CirclePeaks circle_peaks(CircleVotes data, int width, int height, int minimum)
    candidate_count := 0
    CirclePeak[] peaks := []
    for: index < int(#data.cells)
        radius := data.low + index
        denominator := int(#data.outlines[index])
        for: y < height
            for: x < width
                votes := data.cells[index][y * width + x]
                if 100 * votes < minimum * denominator
                    continue
                candidate_count += 1
                peak := true
                for: larger(0, index - 2) <= other_index < smaller(int(#data.cells), index + 3)
                    if not peak
                        break
                    for: larger(0, y - 2) <= yy < smaller(height, y + 3)
                        if not peak
                            break
                        for: larger(0, x - 2) <= xx < smaller(width, x + 3)
                            if other_index == index and yy == y and xx == x
                                continue
                            other := data.cells[other_index][yy * width + xx]
                            left := votes * int(#data.outlines[other_index])
                            right := other * denominator
                            earlier := other_index < index or (other_index == index and (yy < y or (yy == y and xx < x)))
                            if left < right or (left == right and earlier)
                                peak = false
                                break
                if peak
                    peaks = peaks.append(CirclePeak(radius, x, y, votes, denominator))
    return CirclePeaks(candidate_count, peaks)

int[][] line_votes(int[][] edges, int[][] trig, int step, int low, int high)
    votes := [for angle := (0:<180)[] then [for i := (0:<int(high - low + 1))[] then 0]]
    for point := edges[]
        for: angle < 180
            radial := rho(point, angle, trig, step)
            votes[angle][radial - low] += 1
    return votes

int vote_at(int[][] votes, int angle, int radial, int low)
    column := radial - low
    if angle < 0 or angle >= 180 or column < 0 or column >= int(#votes[0])
        return 0
    return votes[angle][column]

int[][] line_peaks(int[][] votes, int low, int threshold)
    int[][] peaks := []
    for: angle < 180
        for: column < int(#votes[angle])
            count := votes[angle][column]
            if count < threshold
                continue
            radial := low + column
            peak := true
            for: angle - 2 <= other_angle < angle + 3
                if not peak
                    break
                for: radial - 2 <= other_radial < radial + 3
                    if other_angle == angle and other_radial == radial
                        continue
                    other := vote_at(votes, other_angle, other_radial, low)
                    earlier := other_angle < angle or (other_angle == angle and other_radial < radial)
                    if other > count or (other == count and earlier)
                        peak = false
                        break
            if peak
                peaks = peaks.append([angle, radial, count])
    return peaks

import pgm_io = "./pgm_io.qui"
import filters = "./filters.qui"
import canny = "./canny.qui"
import hough = "./hough.qui"
import corners = "./corners.qui"

int min_value(int first, int second)
    return if first < second then first else second

int max_value(int first, int second)
    return if first > second then first else second

int cross(int[] first, int[] second)
    return first[0] * second[1] - first[1] * second[0]

int dot(int[] first, int[] second)
    return first[0] * second[0] + first[1] * second[1]

int[] difference(int[] first, int[] second)
    return [first[0] - second[0], first[1] - second[1]]

int chebyshev(int[] first, int[] second)
    return max_value(filters.absolute(first[0] - second[0]), filters.absolute(first[1] - second[1]))

int angle_difference(int first, int second)
    gap := filters.absolute(first - second)
    return min_value(gap, 180 - gap)

int nearest(int numerator, int denominator)
    if denominator < 0
        numerator = -numerator
        denominator = -denominator
    return hough.floor_divide(2 * numerator + denominator, 2 * denominator)

bool has_int(int[] values, int target)
    for value := values[]
        if value == target
            return true
    return false

string words(int[] values)
    fields := [for value := values[] then "{value}"]
    return fields.join(" ")

bool inside_image(int[] point, int width, int height)
    return 0 <= point[0] < width and 0 <= point[1] < height

int[][] bresenham(int[] first, int[] last)
    x := first[0]
    y := first[1]
    dx := filters.absolute(last[0] - x)
    dy := -filters.absolute(last[1] - y)
    sx := if x < last[0] then 1 else -1
    sy := if y < last[1] then 1 else -1
    error_value := dx + dy
    int[][] result := []
    while true
        result = result.append([x, y])
        if x == last[0] and y == last[1]
            break
        doubled := 2 * error_value
        if doubled >= dy
            error_value += dy
            x += sx
        if doubled <= dx
            error_value += dx
            y += sy
    return result

bool circle_before(hough.CirclePeak first, hough.CirclePeak second)
    left := first.votes * second.point_count
    right := second.votes * first.point_count
    if left != right
        return left > right
    if first.radius != second.radius
        return first.radius < second.radius
    if first.y != second.y
        return first.y < second.y
    return first.x < second.x

hough.CirclePeak[] sorted_circle_peaks(hough.CirclePeak[] values)
    count := int(#values)
    span := 1
    while span < count
        hough.CirclePeak[] merged := []
        for: start < count step 2 * span
            middle := min_value(count, start + span)
            finish := min_value(count, start + 2 * span)
            first := start
            second := middle
            while first < middle or second < finish
                if second >= finish or (first < middle and not circle_before(values[second], values[first]))
                    merged = merged.append(values[first])
                    first += 1
                else
                    merged = merged.append(values[second])
                    second += 1
        values = merged
        span *= 2
    return values

bool offset_before(int[] first, int[] second)
    half_first := if first[1] > 0 or (first[1] == 0 and first[0] > 0) then 0 else 1
    half_second := if second[1] > 0 or (second[1] == 0 and second[0] > 0) then 0 else 1
    if half_first != half_second
        return half_first < half_second
    turn := cross(first, second)
    if turn != 0
        return turn > 0
    return first[0] < second[0] or (first[0] == second[0] and first[1] < second[1])

int[][] ordered_outline(int[][] points)
    int[][] result := []
    for point := points[]
        place := int(#result)
        for: i < int(#result)
            if offset_before(point, result[i])
                place = i
                break
        result = result[0:<place].append(point).concat(result[place:<int(#result)])
    return result

class Circle(int[] center, int radius, int votes, int point_count, int[][] outline, int gap, int arcs)
class Segment(int[] first, int[] last, int theta, int length, int pixel_count, int[][] points, line := -1)
class Line(int theta, int rho, int votes, int[] segments)
class Junction(int first, int second, int[] point, int end_first, int end_second)
class Corner(int[] point, int response, match_kind := 0, match_shape := -1, match_part := -1)

class Polygon(int[] segments, int[][] vertices)
    int[] angles := []
    int[] lengths := []
    int[] supports := []
    int[] vertex_corners := [for i := (0:<int(#vertices))[] then -1]
    sigma := 0
    kind := ""

class Shape(int kind, int index, int[][] points, int[][] vertices, int[] center, int radius, int sigma)
    pixel_count := 0
    mean := 0
    contrast := 0
    enclosing := -1

class Component(int[][] pixels, int[] box, int ends, int strength, int direction)
    shape := -1
    explained := 0

int[] circle_gaps(Circle circle, bool[][] edges, int width, int height)
    bool[] hits := []
    hit_count := 0
    for offset := ordered_outline(circle.outline)[]
        point := [circle.center[0] + offset[0], circle.center[1] + offset[1]]
        hit := inside_image(point, width, height) and edges[point[1]][point[0]]
        hits = hits.append(hit)
        if hit
            hit_count += 1
    count := int(#hits)
    if hit_count == count
        return [0, 1]
    if hit_count == 0
        return [count, 0]
    arcs := 0
    for: i < count
        if hits[i] and not hits[(i + count - 1) % count]
            arcs += 1
    gap := 0
    gap_run := 0
    for: i < 2 * count
        if hits[i % count]
            gap_run = 0
        else
            gap_run += 1
            if gap_run > gap
                gap = gap_run
    return [min_value(gap, count), arcs]

bool circumference(Circle circle, int[] point)
    delta := difference(point, circle.center)
    squared := dot(delta, delta)
    return (circle.radius - 1) * (circle.radius - 1) <= squared <= (circle.radius + 1) * (circle.radius + 1)

int[] end_choice(Segment segment, int[] point)
    first_distance := chebyshev(segment.first, point)
    last_distance := chebyshev(segment.last, point)
    return if first_distance <= last_distance then [0, first_distance] else [1, last_distance]

int end_for(Junction junction, int segment)
    return if junction.first == segment then junction.end_first else junction.end_second

bool inside_shape(Shape shape, int[] point)
    if shape.kind == 1
        delta := difference(point, shape.center)
        return dot(delta, delta) <= shape.radius * shape.radius
    for: i < int(#shape.vertices)
        vertex := shape.vertices[i]
        next := shape.vertices[(i + 1) % int(#shape.vertices)]
        turn := cross(difference(next, vertex), difference(point, vertex))
        if turn != 0 and (turn > 0) != (shape.sigma > 0)
            return false
    return true

string shape_text(Shape[] shapes, int index)
    if index < 0
        return "none"
    shape := shapes[index]
    kind := if shape.kind == 0 then "polygon" else "circle"
    return "{kind} {shape.index + 1}"

string[] polygon_kinds()
    return ["equilateral_triangle", "right_triangle", "triangle", "square", "rectangle", "parallelogram", "trapezoid", "quadrilateral"]

class Lab self(pgm_io.Input data)
    int[][] image := data.image
    int[][] trig := data.trig
    pgm_io.Params settings := data.params
    height := int(#data.image)
    width := int(#data.image[0])
    filters.Gradient gradient := filters.gradient(filters.smoothing(data.image, data.params.gauss_size, data.params.gauss_kernel, data.params.gauss_divisor))
    int[][] directions := canny.directions(gradient.gx, gradient.gy)
    int[][] nonmax := canny.suppress(gradient.magnitude, directions)
    canny.Hysteresis thresholded := canny.hysteresis(nonmax, data.params.canny_low, data.params.canny_high)
    bool[][] edges := thresholded.edges
    int[][] edge_points := []
    Component[] components := []
    Circle[] circles := []
    bool[][] circle_edge := [for y := (0:<int(#data.image))[] then [for x := (0:<int(#data.image[0]))[] then false]]
    int[][] line_edge := []
    int[][] line_votes := []
    Line[] lines := []
    Segment[] segments := []
    bool[][] claimed := [for y := (0:<int(#data.image))[] then [for x := (0:<int(#data.image[0]))[] then false]]
    Junction[] junctions := []
    link_index := map<int, int>()
    int[][] graph := []
    Polygon[] polygons := []
    Shape[] shapes := []
    Corner[] detected_corners := []
    circle_candidate_count := 0
    circle_peak_count := 0
    line_peak_count := 0
    corner_candidate_count := 0
    vertices_with_corner := 0
    rho_low := 0
    rho_high := 0
    maximum_votes := 0

    void .prepare_components()
        for: y < height
            for: x < width
                if edges[y][x]
                    edge_points = edge_points.append([x, y])
        for pixels := canny.components(edges)[]
            low_x := width
            low_y := height
            high_x := -1
            high_y := -1
            ends := 0
            strength := 0
            counts := [0, 0, 0, 0]
            for point := pixels[]
                x := point[0]
                y := point[1]
                low_x = min_value(low_x, x)
                low_y = min_value(low_y, y)
                high_x = max_value(high_x, x)
                high_y = max_value(high_y, y)
                adjacent := 0
                for next := canny.neighbors(width, height, x, y)[]
                    if edges[next[1]][next[0]]
                        adjacent += 1
                if adjacent == 1
                    ends += 1
                strength += gradient.magnitude[y][x]
                counts[directions[y][x] / 45] += 1
            direction := 0
            for: 1 <= i < 4
                if counts[i] > counts[direction]
                    direction = i
            components = components.append(Component(pixels, [low_x, low_y, high_x, high_y], ends, strength / int(#pixels), direction * 45))

    void .detect_circles()
        votes := hough.circle_votes(edge_points, width, height, settings.circle_min_radius, settings.circle_max_radius)
        result := hough.circle_peaks(votes, width, height, settings.circle_min_percent)
        peaks := sorted_circle_peaks(result.peaks)
        circle_candidate_count = result.candidate_count
        circle_peak_count = int(#peaks)
        for: i < min_value(settings.circle_max_count, int(#peaks))
            peak := peaks[i]
            outline := votes.outlines[peak.radius - settings.circle_min_radius]
            circle := Circle([peak.x, peak.y], peak.radius, peak.votes, peak.point_count, outline, 0, 0)
            gaps := circle_gaps(circle, edges, width, height)
            circle.gap = gaps[0]
            circle.arcs = gaps[1]
            circles = circles.append(circle)
        for point := edge_points[]
            on_circle := false
            for circle := circles[]
                if circumference(circle, point)
                    on_circle = true
                    break
            if on_circle
                circle_edge[point[1]][point[0]] = true
            else
                line_edge = line_edge.append(point)

    void .detect_lines()
        int[][] image_corners := [[0, 0], [width - 1, 0], [0, height - 1], [width - 1, height - 1]]
        for: angle < 180
            for point := image_corners[]
                value := hough.rho(point, angle, trig, settings.hough_rho_step)
                rho_low = min_value(rho_low, value)
                rho_high = max_value(rho_high, value)
        line_votes = hough.line_votes(line_edge, trig, settings.hough_rho_step, rho_low, rho_high)
        for row := line_votes[]
            for value := row[]
                maximum_votes = max_value(maximum_votes, value)
        peaks := hough.line_peaks(line_votes, rho_low, settings.hough_threshold)
        line_peak_count = int(#peaks)
        base := int(#peaks) + 1
        rho_count := rho_high - rho_low + 1
        int[] keys := []
        for: i < int(#peaks)
            peak := peaks[i]
            order := ((width * height - peak[2]) * 180 + peak[0]) * rho_count + peak[1] - rho_low
            keys = keys.append(order * base + i)
        ordered_peaks := [for key := keys.sorted()[] then peaks[key % base]]
        for peak := ordered_peaks[]
            if int(#lines) >= settings.hough_max_lines
                break
            angle := peak[0]
            row := trig[angle]
            int[][] available := []
            low_u := 0
            for point := line_edge[]
                if not claimed[point[1]][point[0]] and filters.absolute(hough.rho(point, angle, trig, settings.hough_rho_step) - peak[1]) <= settings.segment_tolerance
                    u := point[1] * row[0] - point[0] * row[1]
                    available = available.append(point.append(u))
                    low_u = min_value(low_u, u)
            base = int(#available) + 1
            keys = []
            for: i < int(#available)
                point := available[i]
                order := ((point[2] - low_u) * width + point[0]) * height + point[1]
                keys = keys.append(order * base + i)
            ordered := [for key := keys.sorted()[] then available[key % base]]
            int[][][] groups := []
            int[][] current := []
            for: i < int(#ordered)
                if i > 0 and ordered[i][2] - ordered[i - 1][2] > settings.segment_max_gap * 16384
                    groups = groups.append(current)
                    current = []
                current = current.append(ordered[i][0:<2])
            if #current > 0
                groups = groups.append(current)
            Segment[] pending := []
            for group := groups[]
                first := group[0]
                last := group[-1]
                length := chebyshev(first, last) + 1
                if length >= settings.segment_min_length
                    pending = pending.append(Segment(first, last, angle, length, int(#group), group))
            if #pending == 0
                continue
            line := int(#lines)
            int[] identifiers := []
            for segment := pending[]
                segment.line = line
                identifiers = identifiers.append(int(#segments))
                segments = segments.append(segment)
                for point := segment.points[]
                    claimed[point[1]][point[0]] = true
            lines = lines.append(Line(angle, peak[1], peak[2], identifiers))

    int link(int first, int second)
        match link_index.get(first * int(#segments) + second)
            int index
                return index
            none
                return -1

    void .make_junctions()
        graph = [for i := (0:<int(#segments))[] then []]
        junctions = []
        link_index = map<int, int>()
        for: first < int(#segments) - 1
            for: first + 1 <= second < int(#segments)
                a := segments[first]
                b := segments[second]
                if angle_difference(a.theta, b.theta) < settings.junction_min_angle
                    continue
                da := difference(a.last, a.first)
                db := difference(b.last, b.first)
                denominator := cross(da, db)
                if denominator == 0
                    continue
                lambda := cross(difference(b.first, a.first), db)
                point := [nearest(a.first[0] * denominator + lambda * da[0], denominator), nearest(a.first[1] * denominator + lambda * da[1], denominator)]
                end_a := end_choice(a, point)
                end_b := end_choice(b, point)
                if end_a[1] > settings.junction_distance or end_b[1] > settings.junction_distance
                    continue
                index := int(#junctions)
                junctions = junctions.append(Junction(first, second, point, end_a[0], end_b[0]))
                .link_index.set(first * int(#segments) + second, index)
                .link_index.set(second * int(#segments) + first, index)
                graph[first] = graph[first].append(second)
                graph[second] = graph[second].append(first)
        for: i < int(#graph)
            graph[i] = graph[i].sorted()

    void .extend_polygon(int[] sequence, int count)
        first := sequence[0]
        last := sequence[-1]
        if int(#sequence) == count
            if sequence[1] >= last or self.link(last, first) < 0
                return
            int[][] vertices := []
            for: i < count
                current := sequence[i]
                previous := sequence[(i + count - 1) % count]
                following := sequence[(i + 1) % count]
                entry := junctions[self.link(previous, current)]
                exit := junctions[self.link(current, following)]
                if end_for(entry, current) == end_for(exit, current)
                    return
                vertices = vertices.append(entry.point)
            positive := true
            negative := true
            for: i < count
                point := vertices[i]
                next := vertices[(i + 1) % count]
                after := vertices[(i + 2) % count]
                turn := cross(difference(next, point), difference(after, next))
                positive = positive and turn > 0
                negative = negative and turn < 0
            if positive or negative
                polygons = polygons.append(Polygon(sequence, vertices))
            return
        for candidate := graph[last][]
            if candidate > first and not has_int(sequence, candidate)
                .self.extend_polygon(sequence.append(candidate), count)

    bool near_edge(int[] point)
        for: -1 <= dy < 2
            for: -1 <= dx < 2
                neighbor := [point[0] + dx, point[1] + dy]
                if inside_image(neighbor, width, height) and edges[neighbor[1]][neighbor[0]]
                    return true
        return false

    void .polygon_properties()
        for: index < int(#polygons)
            polygon := polygons[index]
            count := int(#polygon.segments)
            theta := [for segment := polygon.segments[] then segments[segment].theta]
            all_sixty := true
            any_right := false
            all_right := true
            for: i < count
                previous := polygon.vertices[(i + count - 1) % count]
                point := polygon.vertices[i]
                following := polygon.vertices[(i + 1) % count]
                phi := angle_difference(theta[(i + count - 1) % count], theta[i])
                if dot(difference(previous, point), difference(following, point)) < 0
                    phi = 180 - phi
                polygon.angles = polygon.angles.append(phi)
                side := difference(following, point)
                polygon.lengths = polygon.lengths.append(dot(side, side))
                raster := bresenham(point, following)
                support := 0
                for pixel := raster[]
                    if self.near_edge(pixel)
                        support += 1
                polygon.supports = polygon.supports.append(100 * support / int(#raster))
                polygon.sigma += cross(point, following)
                all_sixty = all_sixty and filters.absolute(phi - 60) <= settings.angle_tolerance
                any_right = any_right or filters.absolute(phi - 90) <= settings.angle_tolerance
                all_right = all_right and filters.absolute(phi - 90) <= settings.angle_tolerance
            if count == 3
                polygon.kind = if all_sixty then "equilateral_triangle" elif any_right then "right_triangle" else "triangle"
            else
                first_parallel := angle_difference(theta[0], theta[2]) <= settings.angle_tolerance
                second_parallel := angle_difference(theta[1], theta[3]) <= settings.angle_tolerance
                if not first_parallel and not second_parallel
                    polygon.kind = "quadrilateral"
                elif first_parallel != second_parallel
                    polygon.kind = "trapezoid"
                elif not all_right
                    polygon.kind = "parallelogram"
                else
                    low := polygon.lengths[0]
                    high := polygon.lengths[0]
                    for length := polygon.lengths[]
                        low = min_value(low, length)
                        high = max_value(high, length)
                    polygon.kind = if 100 * (high - low) <= settings.square_tolerance * high then "square" else "rectangle"
            polygons[index] = polygon

    void .detect_polygons()
        for count := [3, 4][]
            for: first < int(#segments)
                .self.extend_polygon([first], count)
        .self.polygon_properties()

    void .measure_shapes()
        for: index < int(#polygons)
            polygon := polygons[index]
            shapes = shapes.append(Shape(0, index, polygon.vertices, polygon.vertices, [], 0, polygon.sigma))
        for: index < int(#circles)
            circle := circles[index]
            x := circle.center[0]
            y := circle.center[1]
            radius := circle.radius
            int[][] points := [[x + radius, y], [x, y + radius], [x - radius, y], [x, y - radius]]
            shapes = shapes.append(Shape(1, index, points, [], circle.center, radius, 0))
        for: index < int(#shapes)
            shape := shapes[index]
            low_x := shape.points[0][0]
            high_x := low_x
            low_y := shape.points[0][1]
            high_y := low_y
            for point := shape.points[]
                low_x = min_value(low_x, point[0])
                high_x = max_value(high_x, point[0])
                low_y = min_value(low_y, point[1])
                high_y = max_value(high_y, point[1])
            low_x = max_value(0, low_x - settings.contrast_margin)
            low_y = max_value(0, low_y - settings.contrast_margin)
            high_x = min_value(width - 1, high_x + settings.contrast_margin)
            high_y = min_value(height - 1, high_y + settings.contrast_margin)
            inside_count := 0
            outside_count := 0
            inside_sum := 0
            outside_sum := 0
            for: low_y <= y < high_y + 1
                for: low_x <= x < high_x + 1
                    value := image[y][x]
                    if inside_shape(shape, [x, y])
                        inside_count += 1
                        inside_sum += value
                    else
                        outside_count += 1
                        outside_sum += value
            shape.pixel_count = inside_count
            shape.mean = if inside_count == 0 then 0 else inside_sum / inside_count
            shape.contrast = shape.mean - (if outside_count == 0 then 0 else outside_sum / outside_count)
            shapes[index] = shape
        for: child < int(#shapes)
            enclosing := -1
            for: parent < int(#shapes)
                if parent == child or shapes[parent].pixel_count <= shapes[child].pixel_count
                    continue
                all_inside := true
                for point := shapes[child].points[]
                    if not inside_shape(shapes[parent], point)
                        all_inside = false
                        break
                if all_inside and (enclosing < 0 or shapes[parent].pixel_count < shapes[enclosing].pixel_count)
                    enclosing = parent
            shapes[child].enclosing = enclosing

    void .match_corners()
        detection := corners.detect(gradient.gx, gradient.gy, settings.harris_window, settings.harris_threshold)
        corner_candidate_count = int(#detection.candidates)
        for: i < min_value(settings.harris_max_count, int(#detection.candidates))
            row := detection.candidates[i]
            corner := Corner(row[0:<2], row[2])
            best := -1
            for: p < int(#polygons)
                for: vertex < int(#polygons[p].vertices)
                    distance := chebyshev(corner.point, polygons[p].vertices[vertex])
                    if distance <= settings.corner_match_distance and (best < 0 or distance < best)
                        best = distance
                        corner.match_kind = 1
                        corner.match_shape = p
                        corner.match_part = vertex
            if best < 0
                for: segment < int(#segments)
                    endpoints := [segments[segment].first, segments[segment].last]
                    for: ending < 2
                        distance := chebyshev(corner.point, endpoints[ending])
                        if distance <= settings.corner_match_distance and (best < 0 or distance < best)
                            best = distance
                            corner.match_kind = 2
                            corner.match_shape = segment
                            corner.match_part = ending
            detected_corners = detected_corners.append(corner)
        for: p < int(#polygons)
            for: vertex < int(#polygons[p].vertices)
                best := -1
                for: c < int(#detected_corners)
                    distance := chebyshev(polygons[p].vertices[vertex], detected_corners[c].point)
                    if distance <= settings.corner_match_distance and (best < 0 or distance < best)
                        best = distance
                        polygons[p].vertex_corners[vertex] = c
                if best >= 0
                    vertices_with_corner += 1

    void .match_components()
        for: index < int(#shapes)
            shape := shapes[index]
            explained := [for i := (0:<int(width * height))[] then false]
            if shape.kind == 1
                circle := circles[shape.index]
                for point := edge_points[]
                    if circumference(circle, point)
                        explained[point[1] * width + point[0]] = true
            else
                for: i < int(#shape.vertices)
                    first := shape.vertices[i]
                    last := shape.vertices[(i + 1) % int(#shape.vertices)]
                    for point := bresenham(first, last)[]
                        for: -1 <= dy < 2
                            for: -1 <= dx < 2
                                neighbor := [point[0] + dx, point[1] + dy]
                                if inside_image(neighbor, width, height) and edges[neighbor[1]][neighbor[0]]
                                    explained[neighbor[1] * width + neighbor[0]] = true
            for: c < int(#components)
                count := 0
                for point := components[c].pixels[]
                    if explained[point[1] * width + point[0]]
                        count += 1
                if count > components[c].explained
                    components[c].shape = index
                    components[c].explained = count

    void mark_pixel(int[][] &canvas, int[] point)
        if inside_image(point, width, height)
            canvas[point[1]][point[0]] = 255

    int[][] overlay_image()
        overlay := [for row := image[] then [for value := row[] then value / settings.overlay_divisor]]
        for segment := segments[]
            for point := bresenham(segment.first, segment.last)[]
                self.mark_pixel(&overlay, point)
        for circle := circles[]
            for offset := circle.outline[]
                self.mark_pixel(&overlay, [circle.center[0] + offset[0], circle.center[1] + offset[1]])
        for corner := detected_corners[]
            for: -2 <= offset < 3
                self.mark_pixel(&overlay, [corner.point[0] + offset, corner.point[1]])
                self.mark_pixel(&overlay, [corner.point[0], corner.point[1] + offset])
        return overlay

    int[][] vote_image()
        int[][] result := []
        for: rho_low <= radial < rho_high + 1
            int[] row := []
            for: angle < 180
                value := if maximum_votes == 0 then 0 else 255 * line_votes[angle][radial - rho_low] / maximum_votes
                row = row.append(value)
            result = result.append(row)
        return result

    string[] lines_listing()
        result := ["lines {#lines}"]
        for: i < int(#lines)
            line := lines[i]
            result = result.append("line {i + 1} theta {line.theta} rho {line.rho} votes {line.votes} segments {#line.segments}")
            for index := line.segments[]
                segment := segments[index]
                result = result.append("segment {index + 1} start {words(segment.first)} end {words(segment.last)} length {segment.length} pixels {segment.pixel_count}")
        return result

    string[] circles_listing()
        result := ["circles {#circles}"]
        for: i < int(#circles)
            circle := circles[i]
            shape := shapes[int(#polygons) + i]
            result = result.append("circle {i + 1} center {words(circle.center)} radius {circle.radius} votes {circle.votes} points {circle.point_count} gap {circle.gap} arcs {circle.arcs} pixels {shape.pixel_count} mean {shape.mean} contrast {shape.contrast} inside {shape_text(shapes, shape.enclosing)}")
        return result

    string[] polygons_listing()
        result := ["polygons {#polygons}"]
        for: p < int(#polygons)
            polygon := polygons[p]
            shape := shapes[p]
            amount := filters.absolute(polygon.sigma)
            area := "{amount / 2}." + (if amount % 2 == 0 then "0" else "5")
            identifiers := [for segment := polygon.segments[] then segment + 1]
            result = result.append("polygon {p + 1} {polygon.kind} segments {words(identifiers)} area {area} pixels {shape.pixel_count} mean {shape.mean} contrast {shape.contrast} inside {shape_text(shapes, shape.enclosing)}")
            for: i < int(#polygon.vertices)
                corner := polygon.vertex_corners[i]
                corner_text := if corner < 0 then "none" else "{corner + 1}"
                result = result.append("vertex {i + 1} {words(polygon.vertices[i])} angle {polygon.angles[i]} corner {corner_text}")
            for: i < int(#polygon.segments)
                result = result.append("side {i + 1} segment {polygon.segments[i] + 1} length2 {polygon.lengths[i]} support {polygon.supports[i]}")
        return result

    string[] corners_listing()
        result := ["corners {#detected_corners}"]
        for: i < int(#detected_corners)
            corner := detected_corners[i]
            match_text := "none"
            if corner.match_kind == 1
                match_text = "polygon {corner.match_shape + 1} vertex {corner.match_part + 1}"
            elif corner.match_kind == 2
                ending := if corner.match_part == 0 then "start" else "end"
                match_text = "segment {corner.match_shape + 1} {ending}"
            result = result.append("corner {i + 1} {words(corner.point)} response {corner.response} match {match_text}")
        return result

    string[] components_listing()
        result := ["components {#components}"]
        for: i < int(#components)
            component := components[i]
            result = result.append("component {i + 1} pixels {#component.pixels} box {words(component.box)} ends {component.ends} strength {component.strength} direction {component.direction} shape {shape_text(shapes, component.shape)} explained {component.explained}")
        return result

    string[] report_lines()
        gradient_nonzero := 0
        gradient_maximum := 0
        nms_kept := 0
        strong_count := 0
        weak_count := 0
        weak_kept := 0
        circle_edge_count := 0
        claimed_count := 0
        direction_counts := [0, 0, 0, 0]
        for: y < height
            for: x < width
                value := gradient.magnitude[y][x]
                if value > 0
                    gradient_nonzero += 1
                gradient_maximum = max_value(gradient_maximum, value)
                if nonmax[y][x] > 0
                    nms_kept += 1
                if thresholded.strong[y][x]
                    strong_count += 1
                if thresholded.weak[y][x]
                    weak_count += 1
                    if edges[y][x]
                        weak_kept += 1
                if edges[y][x]
                    direction_counts[directions[y][x] / 45] += 1
                if circle_edge[y][x]
                    circle_edge_count += 1
                if claimed[y][x]
                    claimed_count += 1
        kinds := polygon_kinds()
        kind_counts := [for i := (0:<int(#kinds))[] then 0]
        for polygon := polygons[]
            for: i < int(#kinds)
                if polygon.kind == kinds[i]
                    kind_counts[i] += 1
        matches := [0, 0, 0]
        for corner := detected_corners[]
            matches[corner.match_kind] += 1
        result := [
            "image {width} {height}",
            "gradient_nonzero {gradient_nonzero}",
            "gradient_max {gradient_maximum}",
            "nms_kept {nms_kept}",
            "strong {strong_count}",
            "weak {weak_count}",
            "edges {#edge_points}",
            "weak_kept {weak_kept}",
            "weak_dropped {weak_count - weak_kept}",
            "edge_components {#components}",
        ]
        for: i < 4
            result = result.append("direction_{45 * i} {direction_counts[i]}")
        result = result.concat([
            "circle_candidates {circle_candidate_count}",
            "circle_peaks {circle_peak_count}",
            "circles {#circles}",
            "circle_edge_pixels {circle_edge_count}",
            "line_edge_pixels {#line_edge}",
            "hough_max_votes {maximum_votes}",
            "hough_peaks {line_peak_count}",
            "lines {#lines}",
            "segments {#segments}",
            "claimed_pixels {claimed_count}",
            "junctions {#junctions}",
            "polygons {#polygons}",
        ])
        for: i < int(#kinds)
            result = result.append("{kinds[i]} {kind_counts[i]}")
        return result.concat([
            "corner_candidates {corner_candidate_count}",
            "corners {#detected_corners}",
            "corners_on_vertices {matches[1]}",
            "corners_on_segments {matches[2]}",
            "corners_unmatched {matches[0]}",
            "vertices_with_corner {vertices_with_corner}",
        ])

    void write_reports()
        edge_image := [for row := edges[] then [for value := row[] then (if value then 255 else 0)]]
        pgm_io.write_pgm("edges.pgm", edge_image)
        pgm_io.write_pgm("hough.pgm", self.vote_image())
        pgm_io.write_pgm("overlay.pgm", self.overlay_image())
        pgm_io.write_lines("lines.txt", self.lines_listing())
        pgm_io.write_lines("circles.txt", self.circles_listing())
        pgm_io.write_lines("polygons.txt", self.polygons_listing())
        pgm_io.write_lines("corners.txt", self.corners_listing())
        pgm_io.write_lines("components.txt", self.components_listing())
        pgm_io.write_lines("report.txt", self.report_lines())

void run()
    data := pgm_io.read_inputs()
    lab := Lab(data)
    .lab.prepare_components()
    .lab.detect_circles()
    .lab.detect_lines()
    .lab.make_junctions()
    .lab.detect_polygons()
    .lab.measure_shapes()
    .lab.match_corners()
    .lab.match_components()
    lab.write_reports()

run()

int integer(string text)
    result := int(text)
    return result

int[] integers(string text)
    return [for value := text.split(" ")[] then integer(value)]

string[] lines(string path)
    content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    result := content.split(NL)
    return result[0:<int(#result) - 1]

class Params(local string[][] rows)
    gauss_size := integer(rows[0][1])
    gauss_kernel := [for value := rows[1][1:<int(#rows[1])][] then integer(value)]
    gauss_divisor := integer(rows[2][1])
    canny_low := integer(rows[3][1])
    canny_high := integer(rows[4][1])
    circle_min_radius := integer(rows[5][1])
    circle_max_radius := integer(rows[6][1])
    circle_min_percent := integer(rows[7][1])
    circle_max_count := integer(rows[8][1])
    hough_rho_step := integer(rows[9][1])
    hough_threshold := integer(rows[10][1])
    hough_max_lines := integer(rows[11][1])
    segment_tolerance := integer(rows[12][1])
    segment_max_gap := integer(rows[13][1])
    segment_min_length := integer(rows[14][1])
    junction_distance := integer(rows[15][1])
    junction_min_angle := integer(rows[16][1])
    angle_tolerance := integer(rows[17][1])
    square_tolerance := integer(rows[18][1])
    contrast_margin := integer(rows[19][1])
    harris_window := integer(rows[20][1])
    harris_threshold := integer(rows[21][1])
    harris_max_count := integer(rows[22][1])

    overlay_divisor := integer(rows[24][1])

class Input(int[][] image, int[][] trig, Params params)

Input read_inputs()
    rows := lines("input/image.pgm")
    image := [for row := rows[3:<int(#rows)][] then integers(row)]
    int[][] trig := []
    for row := lines("input/trig.txt")[]
        values := integers(row)
        trig = trig.append(values[1:<3])
    settings := [for row := lines("input/params.txt")[] then row.split(" ")]
    return Input(image, trig, Params(settings))

void write_lines(string name, string[] rows)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(rows.join(NL) + NL)

void write_pgm(string name, int[][] image)
    rows := ["P2", "{#image[0]} {#image}", "255"]
    for row := image[]
        values := [for value := row[] then "{value}"]
        rows = rows.append(values.join(" "))
    write_lines(name, rows)
